defects.detail: AF61 prints day 31, which does not exist in 2008-06; the column carries no date.
AD17 prints day 29, which does not exist in 2009-02; the column carries no date.
Row 118 should hold the weekday letters but does not; its contents are quarantined, not imported.
Day numbers start at 7 in I117; days 1-6 are implied, so day 1 is column C.
Title 2010!A117 reads "NOVEMBER 2018" but the block sits in sheet 2010; the sheet name wins.

The shift that displaced days 1-6 of the header also pushed the first berth row's cells for those days (North Pier West, row 119) up into 2010!C118:H118; they are imported from there, and what the berth row itself holds under those days (2010!C119:H119, a filler) is not read.
Row 129 should hold the weekday letters but does not; its contents are quarantined, not imported.
Day numbers start at 7 in H128; days 1-6 are implied, so day 1 is column B.
Title 2010!A128 reads "DECEMBER 2018" but the block sits in sheet 2010; the sheet name wins.

The shift that displaced days 1-6 of the header also pushed the first berth row's cells for those days (North Pier West, row 130) up into 2010!B129:G129; they are imported from there, and what the berth row itself holds under those days (2010!B130:G130, a filler) is not read.
Day numbers jump from 29 to 31 at AF28; the printed numbers are trusted.
The header stops at day 30 of 31; later days have no column.
Day numbers jump from 29 to 31 at AI28; the printed numbers are trusted.
